title: This Color-Changing ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Mug Reveals a Hidden Character When You Add Hot Water
summary: The full image on the heat-activated mug reveals slowly, almost as if your drink is coming to life as you sip.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

What better way to start your day than with Derpy, the lovable supernatural tiger from the hit animated movie KPop Demon Hunters ?

That’s what Netflix is surely hoping for with the latest merch release from the Oscar-winning film , which features Derpy on a color-changing mug. The coffee cup starts off as a black mug, but when hot liquid is added to it (say, coffee, tea or hot water), the black fades away to reveal an image of Derpy lurking in the shadows. The full image reveals slowly, almost as if your mug is coming to life as you sip your drink.

CHANGES COLOR

'KPop Demon Hunters' Derpy Tiger Heat-Activated Mug

$22.95

Buy Now ON AMAZON

This is an 11 oz. mug (just a little less than the capacity of a Starbucks “tall” cup) and it’s made from ceramic.

Worth noting: The manufacturer recommends hand-washing only, to preserve the heat-reactive artwork (i.e., maybe don’t put it in the dishwasher). The mug comes in an accompanying KPop Demon Hunters -branded box that’s perfect for gifting.

SAJA BOYS MUG

'KPop Demon Hunters' Coffee Mug – Saja Boys Edition

$11.71 $12.72 8% off

Netflix also has other KPop Demon Hunters -inspired mugs available, including this one, featuring the Saja Boys.

The ceramic mug features full-color illustrations of Jinu, Abby, Mystery, Romance and Baby against a white background. There is a slight glossy sheen to the image, as befitting the starry K-pop boy band. Because this is not a color-changing option, this mug is dishwasher- and microwave-safe.

HUNTR/X MUG

'KPop Demon Hunters' Coffee Mug – HUNTR/X Edition

$18.32

Buy Now

Of course, the girls in HUNTR/X have their own official mug as well, with this one showing Rumi, Mira and Zoey in their demon hunter poses against a black background.

Like the other mugs, this holds up to 11 oz. of liquid (about 325 ml) and it measures approximately 4 x 3 inches in size.

SHINY FINISH

'KPop Demon Hunters' Coffee Mug – Golden Honmoon Edition

$18.15

Fans can seal their collection with this “Golden Honmoon”-inspired mug, depicting the HUNTR/X trio in their performance outfits.

The ceramic mug has a shiny finish and the word “GOLDEN” written in bold across the top. Like the other two mugs above, this one is dishwasher- and microwave-safe.

“Golden” of course, quickly became the signature song from KPop Demon Hunters , topping the Billboard Hot 100 for eight weeks, and winning the Academy Award for best original song earlier this year.

All four mugs above are officially licensed by Netflix and come in a purple-colored gift box, matching the signature color of the film. In addition to using these for drinks, reviewers have also mentioned using the mugs as desk accessories to hold pens and pencils, or as a display piece on a bookshelf.

'DEMONS' ON DEMAND

'KPop Demon Hunters' Couch! Couch! Couch! Ceramic Mug

$18.99

Amazon also has KPop Demon Hunters mugs available for sale as part of its Merch on Demand program, which prints fun, pop culture-inspired phrases and graphics on 11 oz. ceramic mugs.

This one features HUNTR/X’s famous “Couch! Couch! Couch!” saying, and is a great mug to cozy up to whether you’re rewatching the movie or just relaxing at home. You can see more Amazon Merch on Demand mug options here .

The mugs come on the heels of a host of new KPop Demon Hunters merch to hit the internet, including official 3D puzzle kits , weighted pillows and portable karaoke machines .
